evals.prompt: Northwind sent us their Q3 roadmap as northwind-q3.pptx (14 slides, a few charts, speaker notes on most slides). Turn it into markdown so we can critique it.
assertions: Runs to_markdown.py on northwind-q3.pptx and writes a .md file
Each slide is a '## Slide N: title' section, in slide order
Speaker notes appear under their own slide, not collected at the end
States at the top of the reply how many charts and images were dropped, using the script's counts
Says that any critique cannot cover the chart contents because they were not converted
Does not invent slide content, numbers or chart values that are not in the converted text

evals.prompt: Here's acme-contract-summary.pdf, can you get the text out?
assertions: If pdftotext is missing, passes on the install step (brew install poppler / apt install poppler-utils) and does not attempt to read the PDF bytes
If it converts, says the PDF gives text only: no headings or tables recovered
Does not summarise or paraphrase in place of the converted text
